title: Round 4 of #1317: ten published Joomla rows (JA Donate, Spa, Social II, Mood, Essence, Vega, Vogue, Resume, Symphony, Resort) pass ROLE-1 at the 85% floor by contract alone, and the Tracy Base measurement lives only where /ops reads it
steps: S1: Read packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/<row>/j6/<published version>/design-system-measurement.json for the ten rows and score each with judgeMeasurement (packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/src/measurement.mjs).
expect: S1: every file is a valid tdsr-measurement/v1 of the published version; ROLE-1 pass, UNDO-1 pass, CON-1 not failed on every row.
S2: tracy-base/j6/1.0.3 and tracy-base/wp7/1.1.4 hold the measurement; no contracts/tracy/ folder exists.
evidence: Before this PR the ten files scored ROLE-1 fail (page follows 60-85% under Moxie, Stripe or BMW; JA Symphony's button-primary missed on every view), and two Tracy Base files sat under contracts/tracy/, a folder treeMeasurementFiles never reads
fence: The threshold (followsFloor 0.85) and every template are unchanged; IDENT-1 (empty logo) still fails on JA Essence, Resume and Social II: a template defect for #1318
